    a = naive.replace(tzinfo=ny, fold=0)
    b = naive.replace(tzinfo=ny, fold=1)
    print("2027-11-%d 01:30 status:" % day, "ambiguous" if a.utcoffset() != b.utcoffset() else "ok")
